_doc: Station footbridges over the railway (viewer/rail/footbridge.js, rule footbridge-built, gate row footbridge). Local metres (x east, z south), m TAW. Each bridge = straight parts: deck (the span over the tracks: walking surface between two steel plate girders), stair (treads, concrete side walls down to the ground, steel railings), landing (a flat pad). a / b: the part's centre line ends; w: clear width; ya / yb: the walking level at a / b, a number or "ground" (the tile's drawn ground there at build time: the part welds onto it). urbis: the UrbIS Land cover 'Bridges' PB polygon it builds (data/rail/rail.json bridges). osm: the OSM ways it draws (their gravel stripe is left off the ground). ?footbridge=old: none built, as before.
source: OSM 2025 (footway bridge=yes 36870319 / 209187984, steps 903802530 / 533 / 538 / 541 / 544, footway 36870320), UrbIS Land cover 2026 Bridges PB 751 / 752, DTM 2021 (the streets at the ends, the stair feet), DSM 2021 (the deck ends: 81.1-81.7 m west, 81.0-81.6 m south-east of the east one), Google Street View Jul / Aug 2024 + aerial (look only): the west bridge a straight steel trough (grey galvanised plate girders, ~1.3 m, a handrail on top) with a dark red resin deck at the north street's level, a stair down along the north bank to the north platform, a wide stair down to Avenue Prince de Ligne between rendered wing walls; the east one diagonal, the same girders, its two stair heads under grey mono-pitch canopies, a third stair from the north platform up to Avenue Laterale.
